surrounding.trailing:
The Door step banking service can be offered by the bank through any of the following means.
By Banks own regular staff
Outsourcing the operations to a Cash management vendor who have national / regional presence with a good track record. The outsourcing to such vendor will be governed by the outsourcing policy of the bank.
Through banking correspondents empaneled with the bank.
Services provided through outsourcing or through banking correspondents will be through a mutually signed agreement detailing the terms and conditions including charges for executing these services, turnaround time.

llm_analyze_result.description: This table outlines the financial limits associated with different types of banking services, specifically focusing on cash pickup and cash delivery services offered by the bank. It consists of four columns: 'Type of service', 'Savings (individuals)', 'Senior Citizen / Differently Abled', and 'Current Account Customers'. The table spans two rows of data for both cash pickup and cash delivery services. For both services, individuals can save up to 20,000 per instance, while the limits for Senior Citizens and Differently Abled individuals mirror this amount. However, Current Account Customers have a significantly higher limit of 5 lacs per instance for both services. This creates a noticeable distinction in perceived value and access to banking services across customer categories. Overall, the data reflects the bank's commitment to accessibility for specific groups while still offering considerable limits to standard account holders. The policy with respect to service limits is noted to be subject to change, hinting at flexibility in response to varying bank policies over time.
